request.description: Now create a second book card. Add another div element with the class attribute set to card. Notice how you can reuse the same class name for multiple elements to apply consistent styling.

hints.text: You should have two div elements with a class attribute having a value of card.
The second element with a class of card should be inside the element having a class of card-container.
The two elements with a class of card should be siblings.
